pinnedFiles.reason: The file this order extends. Already shows the per-entity saturdayMetadata tagging pattern (kind:'site', kind:'expedition'), the window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ seam, geodesic polylines via Cesium.ArcType.GEODESIC, and the existing fly-to-site <button> control convention (data-testid, aria-label, no visual-style change) that a new 'start the line tool' control should match. A new click handler on the cesiumContainer div (or a Cesium ScreenSpaceEventHandler) is needed to turn a canvas click into PlacePoint/PointRejected; none exists yet.

The exact Gherkin for AC6-AC10 (this order's five @level-ui scenarios): two points complete a line that can be saved; one point cannot; the line follows the shortest surface path; a click beside the globe or on the far-side edge places nothing. AC14's scenario text lives in save-expedition.feature instead, but the claim's own fourth AC bullet already restates it verbatim.

Defines clickAt(lat,lng) (drives a real page.mouse click, but throws if toScreen() returns null -- i.e. it cannot express AC9's 'click on space beside the globe' or AC10's 'click on the far-side edge', since those are exactly the null cases) and getEntities() (reads saturdayMetadata + geometry, needed to assert draft-point/draft-line entities exist or don't). The analyst needs to flag that the new draw-line test will need a raw-coordinate click gesture for AC9/AC10, not clickAt, since no lat/lng maps to 'off the globe'.

distance() and pointInCircle(), radius-parameterized (never Earth's) -- what the new test asserts the 1 km tolerance with, both for 'line follows the shortest surface path between two known sites' (AC8) and for the spec's settled 'two points closer than 1 km are the same place' rule this order's line-drawing must respect when placing a second point.

House style for a getEntities()-based assertion test in this app: cesium fixture import, waiting for settle, and checking saturdayMetadata.kind plus geometry shape. The new draw-line spec will assert kind:'draft-point'/'draft-line' the same way this file asserts kind:'expedition'.

House style for a clickAt()/toScreen()-driven gesture test against the production view -- the closest existing sibling to a click-to-place-a-point test, including how it waits for settle after a camera-affecting action before asserting.

Seed coordinates for every site draw-line.feature's scenarios name by name (Moonwell Spring, Ember Crag, Thornveil Glade, Glimmerdeep Caves) -- the new test needs these lat/lng pairs to call cesium.clickAt() at a known on-land point.

Eleven lines, directly cited by the claim: the post-ship correction that 'the land' means any point on the near side of the globe, sea included -- only space beside the globe and the far side refuse a point. This is the one settled gate a developer could get wrong by assuming an actual land/water check is needed.

Names the commands/events this order implements (StartLine -> LineStarted, PlacePoint -> PointPlaced/PointRejected) and hotspot H2: choosing the line tool again, or leaving the view, discards the unsaved line -- directly backs AC14 and AC15 (AC15 is out of scope here, but the discard-on-restart behavior is not).

The existing Expedition/GeoPoint shape ({id, name?, owner, from, to}) the drawn-but-unsaved line's in-memory data should mirror (minus id/owner/savedAt, since nothing is saved yet), so the next order (reagent-map-save) can hand this order's draft state to SaveExpedition without reshaping it.
